ashley: Planning a short-window miniwave tonight 02:00 UTC. Services: runtime (model/runtime), router, api. Objective: small perf bump + config rollover. Need pins, prewarm, and an explicit manual hold after canary.

ben: region + canary %?

ashley: Canary: 4% EU-west, hold 6m for signals, then 25% global if green. Prewarm router pools + thin-client replicas 18m prior.

mira: Console note: console schema migration still on-going. We must pin console-schema -> schema-v2.3 and disable schema writes during canary. I will flip the FF.

ashley: Pins to apply: runtime -> runtime-v5.1-pr1, api -> api-2026-03-24-rc2, console-schema -> schema-v2.3. Also enable model-quant flag = off for canary.

sre-ops: SRE checklist: set eviction_grace=30s, prewarm routers T-18m, enable fast-failback route to api-legacy, and throttling ceiling at 80% of target. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 2x baseline OR p95 > 350ms sustained for 6m OR kv-eviction spike > 500/min.

ben: put those rollback triggers into the release notes and runbook. Also note: tokenization smoke for quant flag.

mira: Runbook snippet: at T-6m `ffctl set console.schema_writes false`, at T start deploy, canary 4% EU-west, wait 6m -> sign-off window 4m manual hold, then ramp to 25%. On rollback: `deploybot unpin artifacts && router rollback-to stable-route && ffctl set console.schema_writes true`.

ashley: Deploybot, schedule wave with manual hold after canary. Include puppet step to pin artifacts.

deploybot: Scheduled: miniwave-1745557777-02:00UTC. Steps: (1) prewarm router pools, (2) apply pins, (3) disable console schema writes, (4) canary 4% EU-west, (5) wait 6m + manual sign-off (4m), (6) ramp 25% global, (7) re-enable writes and post-checks. Manual hold added.

sre-ops: Dashboards to watch: error-rate (per-route), p95_latency, kv-eviction-count, cpu_50. Alerts: `ALERT if p95_latency > 350ms for 6m OR error_rate_ratio > 2 for 3m OR kv_evictions > 500/min`. I'll attach links after I create them.

ben: Who signs off during hold?

mira: I'll own console + api checks. ashley owns runtime + router. ben you compile notes and watch metrics?

ben: I can watch overall traffic and rollout metrics. Will prepare release notes draft now.

ashley: One more: migration job scheduled at T+20m to reconcile schema. If migration_failure_rate > 0.5% abort full ramp and rollback.

mira: noted. Also will snapshot console home DB before migration: `pg_dump -Fc -f /tmp/console-snap-${thread_ts}.dump`.

ben: Release notes (short): "Miniwave: runtime->v5.1-pr1, api->api-2026-03-24-rc2, console schema pinned v2.3, schema writes disabled during canary, canary EU-west 4% -> 25% global, rollback on high latency/errors/evictions. Manual hold after canary." I'll paste full later.

ashley: All set? If yes, :thumbsup: and we'll execute.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll prepare FF flip command and validate console snapshot prewindow.

ben: :thumbsup:

sre-ops: :thumbsup: creating dash + alerts now, will post links in thread.

ashley: Thanks team. If anyone sees oddness during sign-off we run `rollback-runbook-quick` (unpin + route traffic back).
